name: kalks-monorepo
description: KALKS trading platform: marketing site (apps/web), trader app (apps/trader) and back-office admin (apps/admin)

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n trader,admin,web -c green,magenta,blue "npm run dev:trader" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:trader && npm run build:admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:trader && npm run lint:admin
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/trader ci && npm --prefix apps/admin ci

//deploy: The 'next' devDependency above is a detection shim, not a build input. Vercel reads the package.json at the deployment Root Directory to identify the framework, and this repo's root is only a monorepo orchestrator. Without it the build fails with 'No Next.js version detected'. Keep the version in step with apps/trader. The alternative, and the cleaner setup, is to set Root Directory to apps/trader in the Vercel project settings, which makes vercel.json and this shim unnecessary.
